description: After successful host writing and validation, finalize and upload this run as a draft. In a local folder it saves the article as Markdown with its screenshots and returns the saved path instead of an editor link. Safe to retry after an upload failure without regenerating. The writer finish handshake can already have delivered the draft; still call this tool to get the final response. Never infer completion from the writer’s prose or preview link. Return the editor link, then any show_to_user text verbatim, open only if the returned open_when_ready is true, and ask whether the user wants to publish. Never call for a partial or interrupted writer.
name: supportpages_complete_article
